def VTask.memPartition : {α : Type u_1} → (f : ℕ → Set α) → ℕ → Set (Set α) := by
  intro α
  intro f
  intro n
  classical
  -- Define the partition recursively
  have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), Set (Set α) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      -- Base case: at level 0, the partition is {univ}
      exact {{Set.univ}}
    | succ n ih =>
      -- Inductive step: at level n+1, refine the partition by splitting each piece with f n
      -- For each set s in the partition at level n, split it into s ∩ f n and s \ f n
      -- and collect all such sets to form the partition at level n+1.
      let prev_partition : Set (Set α) := ih
      have h₁ : Set (Set α) := prev_partition.bind (fun s => {s ∩ f n, s \ f n})
      exact h₁
  -- The partition at level n is given by the above construction
  exact h n
